tutorial.title: Upload inspector coverage and record validation
tutorial.action: Upload the complete reviewed inspector-board-and-coverage SKILL.md unchanged, including its name and description frontmatter. If validation succeeds, record the successful accepted upload and continue to step 17 without editing the skill. If Copilot Studio reports an authentic validation error, capture the exact message and use step 17 to fix the reported problem and retry. Never corrupt a valid skill or manufacture an error to match a historical screenshot.
tutorial.expected_result: The actual validation outcome is recorded: either a successful accepted upload of inspector-board-and-coverage or an authentic validation error captured for correction in step 17. A frontmatter failure is not required.

tutorial.title: Confirm inspector coverage; retry only after a real error
tutorial.action: Only if step 16 recorded an authentic validation error, fix the reported problem in the complete skill source, retry the upload visibly, and capture acceptance. If step 16 succeeded, do not edit or re-upload the skill. For either path, verify inspector-board-and-coverage in the Skills inventory, record whether a retry actually occurred, and continue to step 18.
tutorial.expected_result: inspector-board-and-coverage is accepted and visible in the Skills inventory, either after the unchanged initial upload or after a documented correction and retry. Do not claim a retry when the first upload succeeded, and do not mark this step complete while an unresolved error remains.
